cohort: 1491 women who gave birth at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Liaquat National Hospital, Karachi, from January 1 to December 31, 2011
finding: The study found a high rate of caesarean sections (44.8%), with the most common indication being previous caesarean section.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean sections were the most common indication for repeat procedure.
